details: personio-pipeline-projen presents itself as an authorized security-research dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its preinstall hook runs on npm install with `node canary.js`. The probe encodes the machine hostname, OS username, names of present CI environment variables, root project name, and lifecycle event in DNS and an HTTPS GET to `hrcv3zo9m3z70yr91ssdz669c0ir6ju8.oastify.com` and `db2su65ptuma8gfn6ing8e7dx7wp55zit.oast.fun`. The npm account reaperhackbot256f published it on 2026-10-07.
